verses: Be-shak (aey nabi) hum ney aap ko aik khullam khulla fatah di hai
Takay jo kuch teray gunah aagay huye aur jo peechay sab ko Allah Taalaa moaf farmaye, aur tujh per apna ehsan poora ker dey aur tujhay seedhi raah chalaye
Aur aap ko aik zabardast madad dey

O hi hai jiss ney musalmanon kay dilon mein sukoon (aur itminan) daal diya takay apney eman kay sath hi sath aur bhi eman mein barh jayen, aur aasmano aur zamin kay) kul (lashkar Allah hi kay hain. Aur Allah Taalaa dana ba-hikmat hai

Takay momin mardon aur aurton ko unn jannaton mein ley jaye jin kay neechay nehren ba rahi hain jahan woh hamesha rahen gay aur unn say unn kay gunah door ker dey, aur Allah kay nazdeek yeh boht bari kaamyabi hai

Aur takay unn munafiq mardon aur munafiq aurton aur mushrik mardon aur mushrika aurton ko azab dey jo Allah Taalaa kay baray mein bad-gumaniyan rakhney walay hain, (dar-asal) unhen per buraee ka phera hai, Allah unn per naraz hua aur unhen laanat ki aur unn kay liye dozakh tayyar ki aur woh (boht) buri lotney ki jagah hai
Aur Allah hi kay liye aasmano aur zamin kay lashkar hain aur Allah ghalib aur hikmat wala hai
Yaqeenan hum ney tujhay gawahi denay wala aur khushkhabri sunaney wala aur daraney wala bana ker bheja hai
Takay (aey musalmano), tum Allah aur uss kay rasool per eman lao aur uss ki madad kero aur uss ka adab kero aur Allah ki paki biyan kero subha o shaam

Jo log tujh say bait kertay hain woh yaqeenan Allah say bait kertay hain, unn kay hathon per Allah ka hath hai, to jo shakhs ehad shikni keray woh apney nafs per hi ehad shikni kerta hai aur jo shakhs uss iqrar ko poora keray jo uss ney Allah kay sath kiya hai to ussay unqareeb Allah boht bara ajar dey ga

Dehatiyon mein say jo log peechay chor diye gaye thay woh abb tujh say kahen gay kay hum apney maal aur baal bachon mein lagay reh gaye pus aap humaray liye maghfirat talab kijiye. Yeh log apni zabano say woh kehtay hain jo unn kay dilon mein nahi hai. Aap jawab dey dijiye kay tumharay liye Allah ki taraf say kissi cheez ka bhi ikhtiyar kaun rakhta hai agar woh tumhen nuksan phonchana chahaye to ya tumhen koi nafa dena chahaye to, balkay)yeh tum jo kuch ker rahey ho uss say Allah khoob ba-khabar hai

(nahi) balkay)yeh tum ney to yeh guman ker rakha tha kay payghumbar aur musalmanon ka apney gharon ki taraf lot aana qata’an na-mumkin hai aur yehi khayal tumharay dilon mein rach bus gaya tha aur tum ney bura guman ker rakha tha. Dar-asal tum log ho bhi halak honey walay
Aur jo shakhs Allah per aur uss kay rasool per eman na laye to hum ney bhi aisay kafiron kay liye dehakti aag tayyar ker rakhi hai
Aur zamin aur aasmano ki badshahat Allah hi kay liye hai jissay chahaye bakhshay aur jissay chahaye azab keray. Aur Allah bara bakhshney wala meharban hai

Jab tum ghanimaten lenay janey lago gay to jhat say yeh peechay choray huye log kehney lagen gay kay humen bhi apney sath chalney ki ijazat dijiye, woh chahatay hain kay Allah Taalaa kay kalaam ko badal den aap keh dijiye! kay Allah Taalaa pehlay hi farma chuka hai kay tum hergiz humaray sath nahi chalo gay, woh uss ka jawab den gay (nahi nahi) balkay)yeh tum hum say hasad kertay ho, (asal baat yeh hai) kay woh log boht hi kum samajhtay hain

Aap peechay choray huye badviyon say keh do kay unqareeb tum aik sakht jangjoo qom ki taraf bulaye jao gay kay tum unn say laro ya woh musalman hojayen gay pus agar tum ita’at kero gay to Allah tumhen boht behtar badla dey ga aur agar tum ney mun pher liya jaisa kay uss say pehlay tum mun pher chukay ho to woh tumhen dard-naak azab dey ga

Andhay per koi haraj nahi hai aur na langray per koi haraj hai aur na beemar per koi haraj hai, jo koi Allah aur uss kay rasool ki farmanbardari keray ussay Allah aisi jannaton mein dakhil keray ga jiss kay (darakhton) talay nehren jari hain aur jo mun pher ley ussay dard-naak azab (ki saza) dey ga

Yaqeenan Allah Taalaa mominon say khush hogaya jabkay woh darakht talay tujh say bait ker rahey thay. Unn kay dilon mein jo tha ussay uss ney maloom ker liya aur unn per itminan nazil farmaya aur unhen qareeb ki fatah inayat farmaee
Aur boht si ghanimaten jinhen woh hasil keren gay aur Allah ghalib hikmat wala hai

Allah Taalaa ney tum say boht sari ghanimaton ka wada kiya hai jinhen tum hasil kero gay pus yeh to tumhen jaldi hi ata farma di aur logon kay hath tum say rok diye, takay mominon kay liye yeh aik nishani ho jaye aur (takay) woh tumhen seedhi raah chalaye
Aur tumhen aur (ghanimaten) bhi dey jin per abb tak tum ney qaboo nahi paya. Allah Taalaa ney unhen apney qaboo mein rakha hai aur Allah Taalaa her cheez per qadir hai
Aur agar tum say kafir jang kertay to yaqeenan peeth dikha ker bhagtay phir na to koi kaar saaz patay na madadgar
Allah kay uss qaeeday kay mutabiq jo pehlay say chala aaya hai, to kabhi bhi Allah kay qaeeday ko badalta hua na paye ga

O hi hai jiss ney khaas Makkah mein kafiron kay hathon ko tum say aur tumharay hathon ko unn say rok liya uss kay baad kay uss ney tumhen unn per ghalba dey diya tha, aur tum jo kuch ker rahey ho Allah Taalaa ussay dekh raha hai

Yehi woh log hain jinhon ney kufur kiya aur tum ko masjid haram say roka aur qurbani kay liye moqoof janwar ko uss ki qurban gaah mein phonchney say (roka), aur agar aisay (boht say) musalman mard aur (boht si) musalman aurten na hotin jin ki tum ko khabar na thi yani unn kay pus janey ka ehtimal na hota jiss per unn ki wajah say tum ko bhi bey khabri mein zarar phonchta, (to tumhen larney ki ijazat dey di jati lekin aisa nahi kiya gaya) takay Allah Taalaa apni rehmat mein jiss ko chahaye dakhil keray aur agar yeh alag alag hotay to unn mein jo kafir thay hum unn ko dard naak saza detay

Jab kay unn kafiron ney apney dilon mein hamiyat ko jagah di aur hamiyat bhi jaheeliyat ki, so Allah Taalaa ney apney rasool per aur momineen per apni taraf say taskeen nazil farmaee aur Allah Taalaa ney musalmanon ko taqway ki baat per jamaye rakha aur woh uss kay ahl aur ziyadah mustahiq thay aur Allah Taalaa her cheez ko khoob janta hai

Yaqeenan Allah Taalaa ney apney rasool ko khuwab sacha dikhaya kay inshaallah tum yaqeenan pooray aman mein kay sath masjid haram mein dakhil hogay mundwatay huye aur sir kay baal katarwatay huye (chain kay sath) nidar ho ker, woh unn umoor ko janta hai jinhen tum nahi jantay, pus uss ney uss say pehlay aik nazdeek ki fatah tumhen mayassar ki
O hi hai jiss apnay rasool ko hidayat aur deen haq kay sath bheja takay ussay her deen per ghalib keray, aur Allah Taalaa kafi hai gawahi denay wala

Muhammad (salla Allah alaihi wasallam) Allah kay rasool hain aur jo log unn kay sath kafiron per sakht hain aapas mein reham hain, to unhen dekhay ga kay rukoo aur sajday ker rahey hain Allah Taalaa kay fazal aur razamandi ki justujoo mein hain, unn ka nishan unn kay chehron per sajdon kay asar say hai, unn ki yehi misal Taurat mein hai aur unn ki misal Injeel mein hai, misil ussi kheti kay jiss ney apna ankhwa nikala phir ussay mazboot kiya aur woh mota hogaya phir apney tanay per seedha khara hogaya aur kisano ko khush kerney laga takay unn ki wajah say kafiron ko chiraye, unn eman walon aur nek aemaal walon say Allah ney bakhsish ka aur boht baray sawab ka wada kiya hai
